scientific_integrity: The probability law is induced by one common iid continuous vertex labeling and is not that of independently oriented edges. No results about the entire greedy maximal independent set are claimed.
scientific_limitations: The sign dichotomy is restricted to paths and complete rooted regular branching trees; no general theorem for arbitrary nonpath trees is claimed.
The asymptotic correlation at fixed arity refers to increasing height; the limit as arity tends to infinity is taken afterward.
Finite exact checks are independent consistency tests and are not a substitute for the analytic proof.
Earlier equivalent formulations outside the inspected literature cannot be excluded; independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Branching reverses the correlation of local minima and maxima in random tree labelings
